name: CUDA Voxelizer Pipeline
definition: A CUDA-accelerated pipeline that voxelizes 3D Gaussians into a 3D grid, sorts them per tile using radix sort, and renders/backs up gradients via tile-based blending.
summary: The CUDA Voxelizer Pipeline is a GPU-accelerated method for 3D Gaussian Splatting that explicitly constructs a 3D voxel grid to manage Gaussian distribution and sorts them via radix sort for tile-based rendering.
